description.zh:
是否启用声码。

><notice> 如果传入了**true**，必须传入参数**SoundCodeConfig**，否则调用会失败。
></notice>
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the sound code.

><notice> If **true** is passed, the **SoundCodeConfig** parameter must also be provided; otherwise, the invocation will fail.
></notice>

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或**ID**值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
Instance ID. You can view the **ID** of your current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID exists, you must pass this **ID**; otherwise, the invocation will fail.
- If the **Instance Overview** page or **ID** does not exist, you do not need to pass this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh: 项目ID，是项目的唯一标识，您可以通过[项目管理控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects)获取项目ID。
description.en: The project ID, which is the UUID of the project. You can obtain the project ID from the [Project Management Console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects).

description.zh:
声码配置，包含字段如下：


- **SoundCodeContent**：声码营销内容，例如商品的详情地址等。

- **AdditionalDuration**：语料播放结束后的声码播放时长，单位为秒，取值范围为1～15。
description.en:
Sound code configuration, which includes the following fields:


- **SoundCodeContent**: Marketing content of the sound code, such as the product detail URL.

- **AdditionalDuration**: Playback duration of the sound code after the corpus finishes playing, in seconds. Valid values: 1–15.

description.zh: 语料ID，该参数可通过调用[QuerySpeechList](~~217576~~)查询。
description.en: Corpus ID. You can obtain this parameter by calling [QuerySpeechList](~~217576~~).

description.zh: 播报速度，默认值为0，取值范围：-500~500。
description.en: The speech rate. The default value is 0, and the valid range is -500 to 500.

description.zh: 更新创建语料时设置的语料播报声音，可以选择的声音类型通过[GetSpeechVoice](~~217887~~)进行查询，填入返回参数中**VoiceList**中**Value**的值。
description.en: The voice used for speech synthesis when updating or creating corpus. You can query available voice types by calling [GetSpeechVoice](~~217887~~) and specify the **Value** from the **VoiceList** in the response.

description.zh: 音量大小，默认值为50，取值范围：0~100。
description.en: Volume level. Default value: 50. Valid values: 0–100.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为20。
> 单个阿里云账号下的所有RAM用户共享该阿里云账号的配额。
descriptions.en:
## Queries per second (QPS) limit  
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account calling this API is 20.  
> All Resource Access Management (RAM) users under a single Alibaba Cloud account share the quota of that Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot update-speech --voice Siyue --speech-code VlKzbj3XIZ0000CeIHH6vR82JNCSzk00 --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --speech-rate 0 --volume 50 --project-code 4de2c36700008c585e599200 --sound-code-config AdditionalDuration=3 SoundCodeContent=www.taobao.com --enable-sound-code true --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot UpdateSpeech --region cn-hangzhou --SoundCodeConfig '{"AdditionalDuration":3,"SoundCodeContent":"www.taobao.com"}' --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --Volume 50 --EnableSoundCode true --SpeechCode VlKzbj3XIZ0000CeIHH6vR82JNCSzk00 --ProjectCode 4de2c36700008c585e599200 --Voice Siyue --SpeechRate 0
